Method of Attack: Displays bogus login screens over legitimate applications
Steals account credentials, SMSs, device information, and other data
Uses phishing pages to steal passwords, usernames, customer IDs, and 2FA codes
Records screen to capture login credentials for unlisted apps
Encrypted using custom encryption techniques to avoid detection
Impacted Systems: Banking apps (215 apps, including 49 in the United States, 31 in Turkey, 30 in Spain, 22 in Canada, 20 in France, 19 in Germany, and 17 in the United Kingdom)
Attack Vector: Hidden within Google Play apps disguised as legitimate apps
Indicators of Compromise: Apps mimicking legitimate apps like MYT Music
